718:t_2:53.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That is what's filling her heart with sorrow...」

718:t_2:54.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「We are not gods... But gradually, those acts came to carry the arrogance of gods.」

718:t_2:55.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$喜びのアドヴェント$$, who led the four $$御使い$$s, managed the universe with joy.」

718:t_2:56.en:
$$甲児$$
「So he was the $$御使い$$s' leader...」

718:t_2:57.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then what is God? Who is the Supreme God you serve?」

718:t_2:58.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$至高神ソル$$... It is a new sun we created...」

718:t_2:59.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「A system to control the $$オリジン・ロー$$ that rebirthed us as the $$御使い$$s 120 million years ago...」

718:t_2:60.en:
$$キリコ$$
「A system... So an artificial god...」

718:t_2:61.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「It responds to the $$御使い$$s' feelings and produces infinite $$オリジン・ロー$$...」

718:t_2:62.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「But the will dwelling within it came to reject its own actions... what the $$御使い$$s had done.」

718:t_2:63.en:
$$アルト$$
「What do you mean, it rejected itself...?」

718:t_2:64.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「In human terms, it took its own life.」

718:t_2:66.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「So it couldn't bear the pangs of conscience.」

718:t_2:67.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「A will dwelling in matter... It probably evolved and acquired definite power, resulting in that.」

718:t_2:68.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That happened 12,000 years ago.」

718:t_2:69.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$至高神ソル$$ shattered into twelve $$スフィア$$s and countless pieces of $$黒の英知$$, scattering across various parallel worlds.」

718:t_2:70.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Losing $$ソル$$ shocked us, but it did not become a problem immediately.」

718:t_2:71.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「For by then, we had attained $$シンカ$$ to its limit, and could manage the universe without difficulty even without $$ソル$$'s power.」

718:t_2:72.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「But we learned that its existence was necessary to overcome the universe's great collapse, which occurs every 120 million years.」

718:t_2:73.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Couldn't you repair that system called $$ソル$$?」

718:t_2:74.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$ソル$$ is the crystallization of our wisdom. With its constituent factors lost, there is nothing we can do.」

718:t_2:75.en:
$$トライア$$
「And those factors are the $$スフィア$$s.」

718:t_2:77.en:
$n
「The $$スフィア$$s are... fragments of the $$御使い$$s' god...」

718:t_2:78.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So the $$太極$$ $$アイム#pilot$$ talked about was $$至高神ソル$$...」

718:t_2:79.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「We sought the $$スフィア$$s scattered throughout all the universes, and the Reactors who could draw out their power.」

718:t_2:80.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「At the same time, we reflected on our deeds and banished $$喜びのアドヴェント$$, who had led them.」

718:t_2:81.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was... someone banished from the $$御使い$$s...」

718:t_2:82.en:
$$アマタ$$
「During the $$時獄戦役$$, Supreme Commander $$不動$$ called him the last one...」

718:t_2:84.en:
$$万丈$$
「Why didn't you give him a more decisive punishment?」

718:t_2:85.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「We touched the truth 120 million years ago, and completely abandoned conflict.」

718:t_2:86.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「You may not understand, but taking the life of one of our own kind is unthinkable.」

718:t_2:87.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's rich, after you took the lives of countless species out of a twisted sense of duty...」

718:t_2:88.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「We have no knowledge of what he did after that...」

718:t_2:89.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「And $$ドクトリン$$, $$テンプティ$$, and I, who remained, renewed our resolve and pursued our mission to guide the universe correctly this time.」

718:t_2:90.en:
$$刹那$$
「And the result was controlling our Earth?」

718:t_2:91.en:
$$レド$$
「And you destroyed an entire galaxy before our eyes!」

718:t_2:92.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I suspect you did that sort of thing many times during those 12,000 years, too.」

718:t_2:93.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So in the end, you didn't change.」

718:t_2:94.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「There was no other way...」

718:t_2:95.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$ドクトリン$$ grew angry at species pursuing distorted evolution, $$テンプティ$$ enjoyed her power, and I sank into sorrow...」

718:t_2:96.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Did you do nothing but feel sad?」

718:t_2:97.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You're one of the $$御使い$$s, too! Why didn't you stop your companions?!」

718:t_2:98.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「...The universe's distortion was steadily advancing toward the great collapse that comes every 120 million years...」

718:t_2:99.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「To stop it, we needed to guide life in a better direction.」

718:t_2:100.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Anyway, the universe's great collapse is over because we defeated the $$宇宙怪獣$$! We don't need your control anymore!」

718:t_2:101.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「The great collapse is not over yet...」

718:t_2:103.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We should have defeated $$バアル$$ with our own hands!」

718:t_2:104.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「But it is the truth...」

718:t_2:105.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「That is why $$ドクトリン$$ is rushing to destroy those who undergo distorted evolution... those who could become $$バアル$$.」

718:t_2:106.en:
$$シンジ$$
「The universe's great collapse... isn't over...」

718:t_2:107.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No...! Then what was $$ノノ$$ and everyone's fighting for?!」

718:t_2:108.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「...In those circumstances, all I could do was use my discretion to protect those with the potential for $$シンカ$$.」

718:t_2:109.en:
$$シモン$$
「Are you saying we were chosen for that?」

718:t_2:110.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Exactly. You were engraved with the $$烙印$$ to serve as an indicator for your Earth.」

718:t_2:111.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So we were... samples representing all of Earth...」

718:t_2:112.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I also gave you various trials to encourage your $$シンカ$$.」

718:t_2:113.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Is that why you sent us to the $$ＡＤＷ$$?!」

718:t_2:114.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I was also the one who sent the super-dimensional life-forms you call $$バジュラ$$ to Earth.」

718:t_2:115.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Contact with them was another means of testing you.」

718:t_2:116.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're saying the $$フロンティア船団$$ got dragged into that?!」

718:t_2:117.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「And for $$シンカ$$, you sent those with the factors of blood of the beast, mingling of waters, and destination of the wind into the world of civilization of fire!」

718:t_2:118.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「The two worlds born from the space-time disaster called the $$大時空震動$$... Those living on the Earths you call $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$...」

718:t_2:119.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Including those I found in other worlds, I created a paradise on the planet you call $$蒼の地球$$... That was the very best I could do.」

718:t_2:120.en:
$$宗介$$
「And you enclosed it in the $$時の牢獄$$?!」

718:t_2:121.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So... in the end, that was to stop evolution... and even $$シンカ$$...」

718:t_2:122.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「I drew $$ドクトリン$$ and the others' attention to $$翠の地球$$ and created an eternal paradise on $$蒼の地球$$.」

718:t_2:123.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「But $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$, whom I sent there as an observer, acted contrary to the role I assigned him.」

718:t_2:124.en:
$n
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$'s home was destroyed by $$サイデリアル$$... by the $$御使い$$s. So he couldn't accept a $$蒼の地球$$ protected by the $$御使い$$s...」

718:t_2:125.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Now I can understand how he felt... Even if I can't forgive it...」

718:t_2:126.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「In the end, you defeated $$ガドライト#pilot$$. And without knowing my intentions, you rejected the eternity of the dimensional cage.」

718:t_2:127.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$蒼の地球$$'s conquest by $$サイデリアル$$ was a result you brought upon yourselves.」

718:t_2:128.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ probably sent you to the galactic center to show you how powerless you were.」

718:t_2:130.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「When I learned of it, I invited you into the $$カオス・コスモス$$ temporarily to teach you the futility of resistance.」

718:t_2:131.en:
$$サクリファイ$$
「Though I was surprised that you did not stop resisting after seeing a fraction of our power...」

718:t_2:132.en:
$$赤木$$
「You're far too selfish! You forced your goodwill and mercy on us without knowing any of our circumstances!」
